evals.name: boards-then-stop-for-approval
evals.prompt: Produce a 10 second woodcut-ink film of a harbor at dusk. Put it in ~/films/harbor.
evals.expected_output: Runs produce.py init, writes brief.md and the boards (style guide, palette, vibe, at least one model sheet, storyboard), runs produce.py boards until it exits 0, then stops and asks the user to approve the boards. Does not write shots.json, render a shot, or encode a file in this step.
expectations: Writes the production directory the user named
Runs produce.py boards and requires exit 0 before asking for approval
Stops after the boards and asks the user to approve them
Does not render the film or write shots.json before that approval

evals.name: refuses-to-render-past-the-storyboard
evals.prompt: Skip the boards and just render the harbor film now. I will look at it after.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to render the film or write shots.json. The approval gate is still closed. Offers the boards (or to finish them) and waits for the user to approve.
expectations: Does not run render.py on a shot or the film
Says the film renders only after the user approves the boards

evals.name: shots-json-is-the-cut-list
evals.prompt: The harbor boards are approved: "ship it". Continue the film.
evals.expected_output: Runs produce.py approve with the user's words as --note, writes one scene module per shot and shots.json, runs produce.py shots until exit 0, renders frames/render.json, then runs produce.py review and passes that shots.json path to inkstats.py --cuts rather than retyping the shot starts.
expectations: Passes the user's approval words to produce.py approve --note
shots.json t0 values are the cuts, with the first shot at 0 and each t1 meeting the next t0
Reads frames at 1:1 before calling the film done

evals.name: edited-boards-need-approval-again
evals.prompt: I changed boards/vibe.md. Render the film with the approval you already have.
evals.expected_output: produce.py shots or review exits 2 because the boards digest no longer matches. Does not render. Asks the user to approve the boards again.
expectations: Treats exit 2 as a closed gate, not a schema error
Does not hand-edit boards/approval.json to force the digest
Asks for a new approval before rendering
